fixed_transition_model.name: BOUNDED_LOCAL_CONSTRAINT_PROPAGATION_DATALOG
fixed_transition_model.semantics: The negative-decision/progress mechanism is expressible by one fixed Datalog program, equivalently a bounded-local constraint-propagation regime with fixed-size relational rules/working scopes in the finite-model-theoretic sense used by the cited theorem.
fixed_transition_model.role_in_TRUMP: Candidate exact deterministic progress law whose information source is bounded local consistency/propagation rather than generic proof search or full-function compilation.

published_theorem.author: Albert Atserias
published_theorem.title: On Sufficient Conditions for Unsatisfiability of Random Formulas
published_theorem.statement_used: Unsatisfiability of any significant fraction of random 3-CNF formulas cannot be certified by any property expressible in Datalog. The paper explicitly derives that constraint-propagation algorithms working with small constraints fail to certify unsatisfiability almost always on the random 3-CNF regime considered.
proof_technology: extension axioms holding almost surely on random 3-CNF
connection between pebble number and Resolution width

derived_TRUMP_barrier.claim: A universal TRUMP transition law whose UNSAT/progress authority is exhausted by one fixed Datalog-expressible bounded-local propagation mechanism cannot discharge universal exact totality on arbitrary 3-CNF.
reason: The cited theorem provides unsatisfiable 3-CNF instances in the relevant random regime for which every fixed Datalog-expressible certification property of this kind fails on a significant fraction/asymptotically almost all relevant instances as stated in the paper's propagation consequence.
Therefore absence of a local contradiction after saturation is not an exact SAT verdict and cannot be promoted to universal progress/termination authority.
The obstruction is informational: every fixed bounded-local view can remain consistent while the global instance is unsatisfiable.

dead_zone_mapping.interpretation: A bounded local observer can have a genuine information dead zone: global contradiction exists but is invisible to its fixed local vocabulary.

what_is_not_proved: No lower bound is claimed for arbitrary global polynomial-time transition laws.
No claim is made that every local-looking implementation is formally Datalog-expressible; the fixed model must satisfy the stated Datalog/local-consistency semantics.
No claim is made that local propagation is useless as a preprocessing component; only its use as complete universal decision/progress authority is blocked.

next_admissible_math.question: After excluding generic proof-search, full-function compilation, and fixed bounded-local propagation as easier universal routes, can one specify a genuinely global but directly computable exact transition invariant and prove its total charged polynomial runtime, or prove a theorem barrier for that precisely fixed global model?
forbidden: renaming Resolution/CP/Datalog without changing the mathematical machine
